Class Controller

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
mesos.am30.server.Controller
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Remote, IF_GameController
public class Controller extends UnicastRemoteObject implements IF_GameController
Controller for the Players' Moves.
This Class works as the Controller for the Players' Moves, defining the Controller in the ModelViewController Pattern.

      Description copied from interface: IF_GameController
      Client's notification about showing the Rankings.
